reading: Triage is a race between the date of surgery and the time needed for testing and four weeks of prehabilitation. Exercise testing is the accepted reference but too slow; bedside tests are fast but their accuracy is uncertain and their published cut-offs were derived in their own data. The patients who cannot complete exercise testing are the frailest and the ones accuracy studies usually drop. A validation study of pre-specified cut-offs, including those patients, answers whether the fast test can replace the slow one for triage.
